title: After 22 Years, Bleach Anime Ends With Final Episode Timeskip
content: Bleach has officially ended its TV anime franchise with the release of its final episode after 22 long years, and with it gives fans a look at how Ichigo Kurosaki and the others are now living ten years after the fight with Yhwach.
author: ComicBook

title: BLEACH Anime Ends 22-Year Run With Special Ending Movie After Thousand-Year Blood War Finale
content: BLEACH anime has officially ended after a near 22-year run following the release of BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity Episode 50. The final episode released on October 27, 2026, while the original BLEACH anime debuted in 2004.
author: Anime Corner

title: Yukari Kaneko's Hanarabeez Original Character Gets 3-Episode Short Anime
content: The official YouTube channel of Shueisha 's Ribon magazine started streaming the first of three episodes for the short anime adaptation of manga artist Yukari Kaneko 's Hanarabeez original character, on Monday.
author: ANN

title: Black Clover Season 2 Preview Reveals First Look at the Fight Fans Waited 5 Years For
content: Black Clover Season 2 has been working its way through the rematches against the Spade Kingdom’s Dark Triad, and the first look preview for the next episode has dropped the first look at one of the coolest fights yet as Magna steps into action.

title: The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom Anime Casts Minori Fujidera
content: The staff for the television anime of Hifumi's The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom ( Yūkyū no Gusha Asley no, Kenja no Susume ) novels revealed the anime's main visual and an additional cast member on Monday.

title: The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure Anime Reveals Main Visual, Additional Cast
content: The Eternal Fool’s Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure anime revealed a main visual and one additional cast member on Monday. Minori Fujidera joins the cast as Rina. Studio Elle is animating the series set to premiere in January 2027.
